overview_description.description:
At Tabeeby, we ensure that the service is delivered in a convenient way while safeguarding the well-being of patients and healthcare providers. The ultimate goal is to allow people to have unhindered accessibility to Convenient, Affordable, and yet a Quality healthcare system.

Equipped with its digitally-advanced app, Tabeeby effectively addresses the hassle of securing easy access to quality healthcare.

product.name: Doctor Search
product.description: A searchable database that provides general information about physicians, allowing users to find doctors based on specialty and location.

product.name: Organization Search
product.description: A searchable directory offering general information about healthcare organizations to help users find suitable providers based on location and services.

product.name: Appointment Scheduling Platform
product.description: An online system that enables registered users to book appointments with doctors and healthcare organizations through the platform.

product.name: Private Interaction Platform
product.description: A feature that facilitates private communication between registered users and doctors or healthcare organizations for health-related queries and consultations.

product.name: Health Information and Educational Content
product.description: A collection of health-related information and educational materials provided by doctors and healthcare organizations for user reference.
